output.title: Internal ACME library fork; effect on this environment unclear
output.content: The release note only says cert-manager now uses a local fork of the `golang.org/x/crypto/acme` package (#7752). It doesn't describe any change in behavior, configuration, API or defaults. The environment shows cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]. It doesn't show any ACME issuer configuration, and the CRD dimension is absent. So the excerpt doesn't tell us whether anything here is affected. Operators using ACME issuers could check the linked PR for behavioral differences.
